title: S1 Table of: Avian binocular vision: It’s not just about what birds can see, it’s also about what they can’t
journal: PLOS ONE 12(3): e0173235 (supplementary file S1 Table)
why: Binocular field widths for 40 bird species (main's sources note on oa-12, which read the article and not this table).
